items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: And George McCullen. Oliver Alcorn. Buddy Johnson on trombone.

ctx.x: That was the snare drum player of the band. Boy, you want me to call some of the men names in the band? Well, I think you can remember some of the others. Well, I think so. Joe Payan, baritone, no, mellophone. George the Hooker was the bass player. And they had Charlie Love on trumpet. I remember him. Pete. And George McCullen. Oliver Alcorn. Buddy Johnson on trombone. You know him?
I don't remember, I've heard of him.
